description: This file declares functions related to custom engine configurations and control, including setting configurations, disabling LCD, testing scheduling precision, and setting minimal pin configurations for an engine.

methods.name: setCustomEngineConfiguration
methods.description: Configures custom engine settings based on provided parameters.

methods.name: setFrankenso_01_LCD
methods.description: Sets up the LCD display configuration for the Frankenso board.

methods.name: disableLCD
methods.description: Disables the LCD display on the board.

methods.name: runSchedulingPrecisionTestIfNeeded
methods.description: Runs a test to check the precision of timing scheduling if required.

methods.name: setMinimalPinsEngineConfiguration
methods.description: Sets engine configuration with minimal pin usage.

methods.name: setFrankensoBoardTestConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the Frankenso board for testing purposes.
